parsed.name: BACnet MS/TP总线通信接口
parsed.description: 一种用于BACnet MS/TP现场总线通信的接口或网络节点，通常连接楼宇自动化控制器、传感器和执行器，在RS-485类总线上收发并转发报文。实验室中可用于楼宇自控网络联调、设备发现、属性读写和总线通信测试。
parsed.description_en: A communication interface or network node for BACnet MS/TP fieldbus networks, typically linking building automation controllers, sensors, and actuators while sending, receiving, and forwarding messages on an RS-485-style bus. In the lab, it can be used for building automation network integration, device discovery, property read/write testing, and bus communication validation.
